mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal potassium excretion by decreasing aldosterone production and glomerular filtration, increasing hyperkalemia risk especially in patients with renal impairment or concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; avoid concurrent use in patients with renal disease, diabetes, or those on ACE inhibitors/ARBs; consider alternative analgesics if potassium supplementation is necessary.
